hints.title: Fewest changes means BFS
hints.body: Each transformation is one edge, so breadth-first search finds the shortest chain.

hints.title: Neighbors
hints.body: Two words of equal length are neighbors when they differ in exactly one position.

hints.title: Avoid revisiting
hints.body: Remove a word from the available set as soon as it is enqueued.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if end not in words: return 0
available = set(words) without begin
queue = [(begin, 1)]
while queue:
    word, distance = pop_front()
    for each position and letter:
        candidate = word with that letter changed
        if candidate == end: return distance + 1
        if candidate in available:
            remove candidate
            push (candidate, distance + 1)
return 0
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
